name: Nether Gem
summary: Across Tirisfal Glades, the Nether Gem carries Gunther Arcanus’s image to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity. Gunther entrusts it to an emissary after his lost spellbook is returned, opening a path to the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Conduit of Arcane Communion
sections.body: Gunther Arcanus forged or enchanted the Nether Gem on his solitary island in Brightwater Lake. He had broken free from the Lich King's control by his own will, yet suspicion kept him apart from the young Forsaken nation. After his lost spellbook is returned, Gunther gives the gem to an emissary as a gesture of goodwill. Atop the Magic Quarter in the Undercity, Bethor Iceshard channels magic through the stone. Gunther's magical visage appears before the Mage Guild leader, letting the two mages speak across Tirisfal Glades. Their meeting opens a path for Gunther to align with Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken.

faq.q: What does the Nether Gem do?
faq.answer: The Nether Gem lets Gunther Arcanus communicate over a long distance with Bethor Iceshard. When Bethor channels magic into it in the Undercity, Gunther's ethereal visage appears so the two mages can speak directly.

aliases: where does nether gem come from
faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus provides the Nether Gem. He lives on an island in Brightwater Lake and gives it to an emissary for his old comrade Bethor after his lost spellbook is returned.

faq.q: Why is the Nether Gem significant to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The Nether Gem helps bring Gunther Arcanus into the Forsaken. He mistrusted other undead, fearing they remained thralls of the Scourge, but the gem lets him reconnect with Bethor Iceshard and pledge allegiance to Lady Sylvanas.

angles.text: As a mage, you see how arcane masters can bridge vast distances with magical scrying and projected visages instead of risking the journey.
As an undead, you know the stone's delivery marks a diplomatic triumph for the Forsaken, securing Gunther Arcanus as a powerful ally against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade.
